story.title: Born from a gap we could no longer ignore.
paragraphs: Munay was born in 2026 from a deep understanding of our underserved community's needs surrounding sexual healing and sex education.
By addressing the gap in these services, we create intentional healing spaces to learn and heal in community.

about.title: Care that is rooted, accessible and shared.
about.intro: Munay is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2026. We offer sexuality-focused services, workshops and day retreats for underserved survivors.
missionBody: We provide sexuality-focused accessible services, workshops and day retreats for underserved survivors of sexual abuse, assault, trafficking, torture, and intimate partner violence.

Through tailored support, we help individuals reconnect with their bodies and foster embodied healing. Centering accessibility and community care, we offer holistic practices and education that empower survivors to reclaim their sense of self and cultivate a more harmonious relationship with their sexuality.
visionBody: A world where everyone, especially those from marginalized and underserved communities, has the support, tools, and compassionate guidance needed to heal, reconnect, and reclaim their wholeness.
We envision a community where healing is intersectional, culturally grounded, and rooted in the belief that every person deserves to feel safe in their body and empowered in their relationships.

legal.metaDescription: Munay's privacy policy, terms of use and cookies.
legal.title: Small print, deep care.
legal.intro: Here we explain how we care for your data, the conditions of our programs and how cookies are used on this site.

sections.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: Munay only collects the information you share with us through our contact and newsletter forms: name, email address, subject and message. We use it to reply to your request and, if you subscribe, to send occasional updates about our work.
We never sell, rent or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. You can request access, correction or deletion by writing to info@munayinaction.org.

sections.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: Munay's programs are educational and holistic in nature. They do not replace medical, psychological or legal care. If you are in crisis or need urgent support, please contact local emergency services or a qualified professional.
Workshop and retreat registrations are confirmed according to the terms shared for each program. If you need to cancel, write to us and we will do our best to offer an alternative.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site only uses technical cookies needed to remember your language and to keep navigation working. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
You can delete cookies from your browser settings at any time. If we add analytics in the future, we will update this page and ask for your consent.
